en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), beginning with the Couplets on Conjoined and Co-nascent with Mind (Cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānadukādi).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, conjoined with and produced by consciousness (*cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāna*), there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive, and is neither conjoined with nor produced by consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] under root;
three under object ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, conjoined with, produced by, and co-existent with consciousness (*cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū*), there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive, and is neither conjoined with, nor produced by, nor co-existent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the condition of root, six; under the condition of object, three ... pe ... under the condition of non-disappearance, six.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, conjoined with consciousness, originated by consciousness, and following consciousness, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, but not conjoined with consciousness, not originated by consciousness, and not following consciousness, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the condition of root, six;
under the condition of object, three ... pe ... under the condition of non-disappearance, six.
